# V-Lab — Sensors Modeling & Simulation Lab

V-Lab is a virtual laboratory platform for Electrical & Electronics Engineering students at State University. It provides interactive simulations, AI-powered viva evaluation, and automated lab report generation.

## Platform

- [Home](https://vlab-tawny.vercel.app/student)
- [About V-Lab](https://vlab-tawny.vercel.app/about)

## Experiments

V-Lab provides interactive simulations for the following experiments:

### DC Bridges
- Wheatstone Bridge
- Kelvin Bridge

### AC Bridges
- Maxwell Bridge
- Hay Bridge
- Schering Bridge

### Sensors & Transducers
- Strain Gauge (Static & Dynamic Characteristics)
- LVDT (Linear Variable Differential Transformer)
- Thermocouple
- RTD (Resistance Temperature Detector)
- Thermistor
- Photodiode & LDR
- Piezoelectric Sensor
- Hall Effect Sensor
- Load Cell
- Capacitive Displacement Sensor
- Op-Amp Characteristics

## Features

- Interactive circuit simulations with live graphing
- AI-powered viva voce examiner (Professor V-Lab)
- Automated lab report PDF generation
- Class enrollment and teacher dashboard
- Live experiment broadcasting

## Institution

State University, Department of Electrical & Electronics Engineering.
